motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll (lerp 0.12) synced to GSAP ScrollTrigger
motion.parallax: [data-parallax] yPercent scrub 0.6; hero field lines --field-y scrub
motion.reveal: ScrollTrigger.batch on [data-reveal] below the fold: y 34 -> 0, opacity, expo.out, stagger .07
motion.tilt: gsap.quickTo rotationX/rotationY/z on cards, pointer: fine only
motion.pages: @view-transition navigation: auto; card picture shares view-transition-name with project hero
motion.reducedMotion: no Lenis, no reveals, no tilt, ticker and video stopped
